description: An agent-based model where each individual in the population is represented as an agent with specific behaviors and attributes, simulating the spread of a virus through interactions.

behaviors.name: move
behaviors.description: Simulates the movement of a person within the environment.
behaviors.algorithm: Each person moves to a random adjacent cell in the grid.

behaviors.name: interact
behaviors.description: Simulates interaction between persons, potentially leading to virus transmission.
behaviors.algorithm: When two persons are in the same cell, there is a chance equal to the infection_probability that the virus is transmitted from an infected to a susceptible person.

interactions.name: virus_transmission
interactions.description: Transmission of the virus from an infected person to a susceptible person upon interaction.
interactions.effect: If a susceptible person interacts with an infected person, they can become infected based on infection_probability.

files.name: agent.py
files.description: Defines the Person class and its behaviors.

files.name: environment.py
files.description: Sets up the grid environment and manages simulation dynamics.

files.name: simulation.py
files.description: Controls the simulation loop and tracks metrics.

files.name: metrics.py
files.description: Calculates and stores metrics such as total_infected and peak_infection_day.
